body:
Founder real-time: not in tmux, needed a survivable claude startup script. Created /home/fatbaby/tmux-session.sh: wraps 'emily session new > sess && claude --dangerously-skip-permissions' in a detached tmux session (reattach with tmux attach -t <name>). Onboarding prompt bakes in this session's own lesson: run.sh/start.sh source EMILY/var/emily-secrets.env (mode 600), which fails permission-wise for non-owner users -- fall back to 'emily context build' (pure-CLI, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) instead of fighting it, then read CLAUDE.md/BACKLOG.md directly. Commit d2c6a1c, pushed to MONOREPO.

⚓ ☃
title: tmux-session.sh — tmux-wrapped fresh-session entry point
